run_sam_segmentation: run the SAM model to predict segmentation masks from point prompts on an image
show_mask_visualize: create a colored overlay of a segmentation mask on a matplotlib axis
show_points_plot: plot positive and negative point prompt coordinates as colored star markers
show_box_draw: draw a green bounding box rectangle on a matplotlib axis
review_main_pipeline: review the SAM prediction pipeline that loads a model, sets an image, and predicts masks
